title: TimeoutError in remote.sync when syncing the remote store
body:
## Environment

Running Lattice 3.2.0 on macOS 15.3 against eu-west-2.

## Steps

How to trigger it:
- Open Lattice and begin syncing the remote store.
- Upgrade from the previous release and keep the old
  settings.
- Check the log window; the traceback appears there.

## Expected

As on every earlier run, syncing the remote store should
just complete.

## Actual

It fails on every attempt since the upgrade; the previous
release never did this. Right after upgrading the behaviour
changed; the same setup worked on the previous release.

## Frequency

Reproduces once a day or so.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:45 in loop
lattice/sched/runner.py:133 in run_due
lattice/store/remote.py:74 in sync_all
lattice/store/remote.py:146 in sync
TimeoutError: sync did not finish within 30s (host=eu-west-2)
